title: An Artinian ring whose residue ring is finite over a subring is finite over it
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings with $B$ Artinian (every descending chain of ideals stabilizes), and let $J(B)$ be the Jacobson radical of $B$. If $B/J(B)$ is a finitely generated $A$-module, then $B$ is a finitely generated $A$-module. More generally, any Artinian (or Noetherian) $B$-module $M$ is finitely generated as an $A$-module.
